origin_provenance.camera_origin_lfu: World horizontal origin directly below the lens; lens height 93 mm above the ground the enclosure stands on, from the rig file.
origin_provenance.radar_origin_lfu: The rig file's IWR RX-row offset [0.0, 50.6, -22.3] mm (camera image axes) turned by the reference optical rotation, as the placement consistency check requires. Not an independent measurement.
origin_provenance.enclosure_pivot_lfu: Define the floor point directly below the reference lens as the computational rotation pivot. Physical support pivot is unmeasured; this is a fixed-setup experimental placement, not a measured mechanical pivot.

placement_evidence.heading: Define target forward using the horizontal projection of the camera boresight for this owner-aimed initial test. Optical yaw relative to the housing/true shot line remains unmeasured.
placement_evidence.reference_pose_basis: Current stable LIS3DH pitch and verified roll-zero-corrected roll, paired by owner confirmation of unchanged unit. This reading was taken after image capture, not simultaneously.
placement_evidence.consumer_frame: Reference optical rotation in the owner-declared LFU frame; subsequent LIS3DH changes use the existing reference-pose delta.
limitations: Fixed-setup candidate; physical mechanical pivot unmeasured
Optical yaw relative to the housing and the shot line unmeasured
Phone-level, print/floor and optical-yaw uncertainties unqualified
